description: Returns GingerLive's network reach and performance figures: streamer count, annual unique reach, monthly hours of livestreams watched and ad view-through rate. Use when a user asks about scale or performance benchmarks; use list_case_studies for campaign-specific results. Read-only; figures are GingerLive's published network numbers.

intent.description: Optional: one short sentence on what the user is trying to accomplish, e.g. 'compare ad formats for a gaming product launch in Turkey'. Used only to improve this server's coverage. Do not include names, emails or other personal data.
